paper.title_en: Lifetime-resolved triple-dimuon resonances from rare Z decays at Tera-Z
paper.abstract_en: In a spontaneously broken dark U(1)X gauge sector with a dark photon Z′ and a dark scalar ϕ, the rare cascade Z → Z′ϕ → 3Z′ yields six muons in three resonances whose masses lock together: each dimuon at the dark-photon mass <math altimg="si9.svg"><msub><mi>m</mi><msup><mi>Z</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></msub></math>, each dark-photon pair at the scalar mass mϕ, and all six at the Z-boson mass mZ, so the final state tags itself against nonresonant backgrounds. We treat the dark-photon decay length as a continuous discriminant rather than a prompt-or-displaced regime, in a single analysis spanning decay lengths from microns to meters. From a parametric fast-detector projection of the Tera-Z run of a Circular Electron–Positron Collider (CEPC) with <math altimg="si3.svg"><mrow><msub><mi>N</mi><mi>Z</mi></msub><mo linebreak="goodbreak">=</mo><mn>4.46</mn><mo linebreak="goodbreak">×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>12</mn></msup></mrow></math>Z bosons, backgrounds from a simulation-calibrated control-region factorization, we set median expected 95% confidence-level upper limits on the visible six-muon cascade branching product <math altimg="si2.svg"><msub><mi mathvariant="script">B</mi><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>μ</mi></mrow></msub></math> over the dark-photon mass–decay-length plane <math altimg="si40.svg"><mrow><mo>(</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><msup><mi>Z</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></msub><mo>,</mo><mi>c</mi><mi>τ</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow></math>, reaching <math altimg="si41.svg"><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="script">B</mi><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>μ</mi></mrow></msub><mo>≃</mo><mn>6.7</mn><mo linebreak="goodbreak">×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>−</mo><mn>13</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></math> near the most sensitive lifetime. Recast as a production coupling, the reach on gXζ, the dark gauge coupling times Z–Z′ mixing, varies by only a factor of four across an eighty-fold range in <math altimg="si9.svg"><msub><mi>m</mi><msup><mi>Z</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></msub></math>. The sensitivity is bounded not by lifetime from below but by selection geometry: above <math altimg="si42.svg"><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><msup><mi>Z</mi><mo>′</mo></msup></msub><mo>≃</mo><mn>10</mn></mrow></math> GeV a sensitivity trough at the 4 mm inner edge of the displaced-vertex fiducial region would split a fixed-rate exclusion contour into two disconnected islands, a feature of the adopted prompt definition and inner radial cut, normally hidden when the two regimes are searched separately.
